question: How long do GCM Netting Solutions typically last, and when should I replace them?
answer:
The lifespan of your GCM Safety Net in Chennai depends on various factors, including the environment and the type of net used. However, due to the high-quality materials we use, you can generally expect our nets to last for many years. We primarily use high-density polyethylene (HDPE) material, known for its strength and durability. All our safety nets are also UV stabilized to withstand the harsh Chennai sun, preventing premature degradation. Generally, you can expect a lifespan of 5-7 years with proper care.

While our nets are robust, regular inspection is crucial. Look for signs of wear and tear, such as fraying, tears, or significant sagging. If you notice any of these issues, it's time to consider replacement. Our safety nets come with a warranty of 3-5 years, depending on the specific product.
